scripts.lint:fix: command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 && (gofmt -w . && go vet ./...) || (echo 'api: skipping lint:fix (go not installed)' && exit 0)
scripts.docs: go tool swag init --generalInfo main.go --dir cmd/api,internal/delivery/http --output docs --parseInternal
scripts.docs:check: pnpm run docs && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- docs)"
